title: hieracium caesium subsp. porrigens
intro: Hieracium caesium subsp. porrigens, commonly known as mountain cornflower, is a plant species in the dandelion family (Asteraceae). This plant has been found to possess various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may aid in reducing inflammation and protecting against oxidative stress. The therapeutic actions of Hieracium caesium subsp. porrigens include its potential in treating digestive issues, such as bloating and constipation, due to its prebiotic properties and the presence of bioactive constituents like flavonoids and phenolic acids. Research suggests that the bioactive constituents of this plant, including sesquiterpenes and phenolic compounds, may contribute to its therapeutic effects.
